Hello, everyone. • Welcome to your first day at Seaside
Garments. We're very excited to be working with such a
talented group of graphic designers as we create our first
young-adult clothing line. ® Since we're expanding into a
younger market, we'd like to use this opportunity to reinvent
our image. So, Othe first thing we'd like you to do is take a
look at the company logo. We've had it for quite a while. You
were hired for your creativity and familiarity with the young
adult market, so please think about how we can appeal to
this demographic as you begin your work today.
